description: Point one or more hostnames at the given (or the caller's apparent) IP address using Domeneshop's dynamic DNS protocol. The record type (A or AAAA) follows from the address; a missing record is created, an existing one overwritten.

hostname.description: the fully qualified hostname to update, e.g. 'home.example.com'; several hostnames can be updated at once by separating them with commas

myip.description: the IP address to set, IPv4 or IPv6; up to 9 addresses may be comma-separated, e.g. '192.0.2.1,2001:db8::1'. If omitted or empty, Domeneshop uses the caller's apparent IP

name: update_dyndns
title: Update dynamic DNS
